{
  "findings": [
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_AWS_129",
      "title": "RDS log exports are not enabled",
      "resource": "aws_db_instance.levelup-rds",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The instance does not export database logs to CloudWatch, reducing visibility into database errors, suspicious activity, and operational events."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_AWS_16",
      "title": "RDS storage encryption is not enabled",
      "resource": "aws_db_instance.levelup-rds",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The instance omits storage encryption, so its database storage, automated backups, and snapshots are not explicitly encrypted at rest."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_AWS_118",
      "title": "RDS enhanced monitoring is not enabled",
      "resource": "aws_db_instance.levelup-rds",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "No enhanced monitoring interval or monitoring role is configured, limiting operating-system-level telemetry available for security and incident investigation."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_AWS_293",
      "title": "RDS deletion protection is not enabled",
      "resource": "aws_db_instance.levelup-rds",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "Deletion protection is absent, allowing the database instance to be deleted accidentally or by a compromised deployment identity."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_AWS_353",
      "title": "RDS Performance Insights is not enabled",
      "resource": "aws_db_instance.levelup-rds",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "Performance Insights is not enabled, reducing database workload visibility that can help identify anomalous or abusive query behavior."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_AWS_157",
      "title": "RDS Multi-AZ deployment is disabled",
      "resource": "aws_db_instance.levelup-rds",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The instance explicitly disables Multi-AZ, leaving the database without a synchronous standby in another Availability Zone for resilience."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV2_AWS_60",
      "title": "RDS snapshot tag copying is not enabled",
      "resource": "aws_db_instance.levelup-rds",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "Tags are not copied to snapshots, which can prevent security classification, ownership, and access-control tags from following database backups."
    }
  ],
  "patched_code": "resource "aws_iam_role" "levelup-rds-monitoring" {
  name = "${var.ENVIRONMENT}-levelup-rds-monitoring"

  assume_role_policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [
      {
        Effect = "Allow"
        Principal = {
          Service = "monitoring.rds.amazonaws.com"
        }
        Action = "sts:AssumeRole"
      }
    ]
  })
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "levelup-rds-monitoring" {
  role       = aws_iam_role.levelup-rds-monitoring.name
  policy_arn = "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonRDSEnhancedMonitoringRole"
}

resource "aws_db_instance" "levelup-rds" {
  identifier              = "${var.ENVIRONMENT}-levelup-rds"
  allocated_storage       = var.LEVELUP_RDS_ALLOCATED_STORAGE
  storage_type            = "gp2"
  storage_encrypted       = true
  engine                  = var.LEVELUP_RDS_ENGINE
  engine_version          = var.LEVELUP_RDS_ENGINE_VERSION
  instance_class          = var.DB_INSTANCE_CLASS
  backup_retention_period = var.BACKUP_RETENTION_PERIOD
  publicly_accessible     = var.PUBLICLY_ACCESSIBLE
  username                = var.LEVELUP_RDS_USERNAME
  password                = var.LEVELUP_RDS_PASSWORD
  vpc_security_group_ids  = [aws_security_group.levelup-rds-sg.id]
  db_subnet_group_name    = aws_db_subnet_group.levelup-rds-subnet-group.name

  enabled_cloudwatch_logs_exports = lookup({
    mysql          = toset(["error", "general", "slowquery"])
    mariadb        = toset(["error", "general", "slowquery"])
    postgres       = toset(["postgresql", "upgrade"])
    oracle-ee      = toset(["alert", "audit", "listener", "trace"])
    oracle-ee-cdb  = toset(["alert", "audit", "listener", "trace"])
    oracle-se2     = toset(["alert", "audit", "listener", "trace"])
    oracle-se2-cdb = toset(["alert", "audit", "listener", "trace"])
    sqlserver-ee   = toset(["error"])
    sqlserver-se   = toset(["error"])
    sqlserver-ex   = toset(["error"])
    sqlserver-web  = toset(["error"])
    db2-ae         = toset(["diaglogs", "notifylogs"])
    db2-se         = toset(["diaglogs", "notifylogs"])
  }, var.LEVELUP_RDS_ENGINE, toset([]))

  monitoring_interval             = 60
  monitoring_role_arn             = aws_iam_role.levelup-rds-monitoring.arn
  deletion_protection             = true
  performance_insights_enabled    = true
  multi_az                        = true
  copy_tags_to_snapshot           = true
}
",
  "fix_summary": "Enabled encryption, engine-appropriate CloudWatch log exports, enhanced monitoring, deletion protection, Performance Insights, Multi-AZ, and snapshot tag propagation. Added the service role required by RDS enhanced monitoring; automatic minor upgrades were not changed because the provider default is already enabled."
}
